title: Appeals and Grievances Inpatient Pricing Note: Payment Difference on a Paid TRICARE Select Line
content:
Inpatient pricing note — Appeals and Grievances

**Subject.** The amount in dispute on an Allowable Charge Review of a paid TRICARE Select inpatient line.

1. The amount in dispute on an Allowable Charge Review of a paid TRICARE Select inpatient line is the payment difference on the line: the TRICARE payment the line would carry at the allowed amount claimed, less the TRICARE payment the line shows, never below zero and rounded to the cent.
2. The allowed amount claimed on the line under review is its covered days at its paid daily rate — the covered days multiplied by that rate, rounded to the cent — the paid daily rate being its allowed amount divided by its covered days and rounded to the cent.
3. The payment the line under review would carry at the allowed amount claimed is that allowed amount less the cost share figured on it, the cost share being the daily inpatient charge of the tier for each covered day, never less than the tier's minimum inpatient charge.
4. Records read: on the line's own TRICARE Select record, its service date, claim number, facility, covered inpatient days, allowed amount, TRICARE payment and the facility's network status; the daily inpatient charge is the tier's network or non-network daily charge as the facility is recorded, and the tier is that of the TRICARE Select enrollment the line was billed under.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Covered days 5; allowed amount 4,250.00; paid daily rate 850.00; allowed amount claimed 4,250.00. Daily inpatient charge 250.00 and minimum 25.00: cost share 1,250.00. Payment at the allowed amount claimed: 3,000.00.

| TRICARE payment the line shows | Payment difference, the amount in dispute |
|---|---|
| 2,875.00 | 125.00 |
| 3,000.00 | 0.00 |
| 3,100.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |
